name: generate_image
description:
按文字提示生成图片，返回本地路径；可传 reference_images 做图生图。
Generate an image from a text prompt using the configured OpenAI or RightCode image API. Pass reference_images to work from existing pictures (image-to-image); each entry takes the same kind of reference vision_analyze accepts. On messaging platforms a reference must be attached to the current turn, listed in the chat history as context_image_N, or a trusted avatar URL. Emits an image event and returns a local path. Messaging platforms deliver emitted images automatically, so do not pass the same image to send_message_to_user. Do not call print_image unless the user explicitly asks to display it.

reference_images.description: 可选参考图，做图生图。取值与 vision_analyze 的 image 一样：本地图片路径、http(s) 图片 URL，或聊天记录里的 context_image_N。
